collection.title: Daihatsu Sportrak 1989 to 1998 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit the Daihatsu Sportrak 1989 to 1998 which requires a 17" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
